entries.toelichting: Northeastern boundary site (Eze 47:17; 48:1). Hyphenated. English convention: Hazar-enon. 'Spring-village'.
Same locale (Num 34:9,10). Hyphenated. English convention: Hazar-enan.
Simeonite town (Josh 15:28; 19:3; 1Chr 4:28; Neh 11:27). Hyphenated. English convention: Hazar-shual. 'Fox-village'.
Pu/Hithp: be-engraved, traced (1Kgs 6:35; Eze 8:10; 23:14; Job 13:27). Hyphenated to mark cutting-into-surface; family with H2710.
Nethinim ancestor (Ezr 2:51; Neh 7:53). English convention: Hakupha.

Qal/Po/Pu/Hophal: cut-into, decree, ordain (Gen 49:10; Num 21:18; Deut 33:21; Judg 5:9,14; Job 19:23; Ps 60:7; 108:8; Prov 8:15,27,29; 31:5; Isa 10:1; 22:16; 30:8; 33:22; 49:16; Eze 4:1; 8:10; 23:14; Hos 5:11). Hyphenated to mark legislative-engraving.
Judg 5:15 'great-resolves-of-heart'; Isa 10:1. Hyphenated to mark thought-out-or-engraved-decision.
Searching, depth-of-inquiry (Judg 5:16; Job 5:9; 8:8; 9:10; 11:7; 34:24; 36:26; 38:16; Ps 145:3; Prov 25:3; Isa 40:28). Standard concordant 'investigation'.

Qal/Ni/Pu/Hi/Hophal: be-desolate (Judg 16:24; 2Kgs 19:17; Isa 19:6; 34:10; 37:18; 42:15; 50:2; 60:12; Jer 26:9; 50:21,27; Eze 6:6; 12:20; 19:7; 26:2,19; 29:12; 30:7; Hos 13:15; Amos 7:9; Nah 3:7; Zeph 3:6). Hyphenated to mark devastation-aspect.
Qal: dried up of waters (Gen 8:13; Isa 19:5; Jer 51:36). Hyphenated to distinguish drought-aspect from H2717a desolation.
Adjective combining drought and desolation (Lev 7:10; Ezra 9:9; Prov 17:1; Hag 1:4,9). Hyphenated to mark dual-aspect.
Aramaic Hophal; Ezr 4:15 'this-city-was-laid-waste'. Hyphenated with -aramaic suffix.
Adjective: laid-waste, ruined (Neh 2:3,17; Jer 26:9; Eze 36:35,38; Zeph 3:6). Hyphenated.
Adjective marking emptiness (Hag 1:4,9). Hyphenated to distinguish from H2720a.
Dry-heat (Gen 31:40; Deut 28:22; Job 30:30; Ps 32:4; Isa 4:6; 25:4,5; Jer 36:30; 50:38; Hag 1:11). Hyphenated.
Sword-sharpness, devastation (Isa 4:6; Jer 50:27). Hyphenated to mark slaughter-aspect.

Mountain of the law-giving, Sinai's other name (Ex 3:1; 17:6; 33:6; Deut 1:2,6,19; 4:10,15; 5:2; 9:8; 18:16; 28:69; 1Kgs 8:9; 19:8; 2Chr 5:10; Ps 106:19; Mal 4:4). English convention: Horeb. 'Desolate-place'.
Dry-bed of sea or river (Gen 7:22; Ex 14:21; Josh 3:17; 4:18; 2Kgs 2:8; Eze 30:12; Hag 2:6). Hyphenated.
Persian eunuch of Ahasuerus (Esth 1:10; 7:9). English convention: Harbona.
Edible locust species (Lev 11:22). Hyphenated to distinguish from H697 arbeh swarm-locust and H2284 chagav grasshopper.
Adjective: shaking-with-fear (Judg 7:3; 1Sam 4:13; Ezr 9:4; 10:3; Isa 66:2,5). Standard concordant 'trembling'.
Anxious-fear (Gen 27:33; 1Sam 14:15; Prov 29:25; Isa 21:4; Jer 30:5; Eze 26:16). Hyphenated.
Inhabitant of Harod (2Sam 23:25). English convention: Harodite.
Wilderness camp-station (Num 33:32,33). Hyphenated. English convention: Hor-Haggidgad. 'Cleft-of-the-trembling'.
Father of Jedaiah, wall-builder (Neh 3:10). English convention: Harumaph.
Post-exilic family-head (Neh 7:24; 10:19). Hyphenated. English convention: Hariph.
Threshing-sledge with sharp teeth (2Sam 12:31; Isa 28:27; 41:15; Amos 1:3; Job 41:30). Hyphenated.
Refined-gold poetic-term (Ps 68:13; Prov 3:14; 8:10,19; 16:16; Zech 9:3). Hyphenated to mark choice-gold distinct from H2091 zahav.
Father of Meshullemeth (2Kgs 21:19). English convention: Haruz.
Nethinim ancestor (Ezr 2:51; Neh 7:53). English convention: Harhur.
Grandfather of Huldah's husband (2Kgs 22:14). English convention: Harhas.
Egyptian/Babylonian sacred-scribe-magician (Gen 41:8,24; Ex 7:11,22; 8:7,18,19; 9:11; Dan 1:20; 2:2). Hyphenated to mark sacred-scholar-of-magic distinct from H3784 kashaf sorcerer.
Pre-Edomite cave-dwelling people (Gen 14:6; 36:20,21,29,30; Deut 2:12,22). English convention: Horite.
Horite chieftain and Simeonite spy's father (Gen 36:22; Num 13:5). English convention: Hori.
Qal: be-disfigured (Lev 22:22 'maimed-or-mutilated'). Hyphenated to mark physical-defect.

What-is-devoted-and-banned (Lev 27:21,28,29; Num 18:14; Deut 7:26; 13:17; Josh 6:17,18; 7:1,11,12,13,15; 22:20; 1Sam 15:21; 1Kgs 20:42; 1Chr 2:7; Isa 34:5; 43:28; Eze 44:29; Mic 4:13; Zech 14:11; Mal 3:24). Hyphenated to mark dedicated-cursed-thing distinct from H423 alah curse.
Hunting/fishing net (Ecc 7:26; Eze 26:5,14; 32:3; 47:10; Mic 7:2; Hab 1:15-17). Hyphenated to mark trap-net distinct from H7568 resheth net.
Priestly division-head and post-exilic ancestors (1Chr 24:8; Ezr 2:32,39; 10:21,31; Neh 3:11; 7:35,42; 10:5,27; 12:15). English convention: Harim.
Negev city devoted to destruction (Num 14:45; 21:3; Deut 1:44; Josh 12:14; 15:30; 19:4; Judg 1:17; 1Sam 30:30; 1Chr 4:30). English convention: Hormah. 'Devoted-to-destruction'.
Northern boundary-mountain (Deut 3:8,9; 4:48; Josh 11:3,17; 12:1,5; 13:5,11; 1Chr 5:23; Ps 42:6; 89:12; 133:3; Song 4:8). English convention: Hermon.
Ps 42:6 'from-the-Hermons' — plural-form for the mountain-range. Standard concordant.
Mesopotamian city of Abram's stay (Gen 11:31,32; 12:4,5; 27:43; 28:10; 29:4; 2Kgs 19:12; Isa 37:12; Eze 27:23; Acts 7:2,4). English convention: Haran.
Son of Caleb by Ephah (1Chr 2:46). Hyphenated.
Sanballat the Horonite (Neh 2:10,19; 13:28). English convention: Horonite.
Moabite town (Isa 15:5; Jer 48:3,5,34). English convention: Horonaim.
Poetic sun (Judg 8:13; 14:18; Job 9:7). Standard concordant 'sun'; distinct from H8121 shemesh by poetic register.
Amorite-held mountain (Judg 1:35). Hyphenated. English convention: Mount Heres.
Cool-rainy season (Gen 8:22; Job 29:4; Ps 74:17; Prov 20:4; Jer 36:22; Amos 3:15; Zech 14:8). Hyphenated.
Qal/Ni: cut, decree-decisively (Ex 11:7; Lev 22:22; Josh 10:21; 2Sam 5:24; 1Kgs 20:40; Job 14:5; Isa 10:23; 28:22; Dan 9:26,27; 11:36). Hyphenated to mark cutting-into-decision.
Ps 73:4; Isa 58:6. Hyphenated to mark binding-cords-of-injustice.
Qal/Ni/Pilpel: be-scorched (Job 30:30; Ps 69:3; 102:3; Prov 6:28; Isa 24:6; Jer 6:29; 17:6; Eze 15:4,5; 24:11). Hyphenated.
Pottery-fragment (Lev 6:21; 11:33; 14:5,50; 15:12; Num 5:17; Ps 22:15; Prov 26:23; Isa 30:14; 45:9; Jer 19:1; 32:14; Lam 4:2; Eze 23:34). Standard concordant 'potsherd'.

Qal: plow-fields, also engrave (Deut 22:10; Judg 14:18; 1Sam 8:12; 14:14; 1Kgs 19:19; Job 1:14; 4:8; Ps 129:3; Prov 3:29; 6:14,18; 12:20; 14:22; 20:4; 21:4; Isa 28:24; 45:9; Jer 17:1; 26:18; Hos 10:11,13; Amos 6:12; 9:13; Mic 3:12). Hyphenated to mark dual sense of agricultural-and-craft-cutting.
Nethinim ancestor (Ezr 2:52; Neh 7:54). English convention: Harsha.
Forest where David hid (1Sam 22:5). English convention: Hereth.
Ephod's-belt of skilful-work (Ex 28:8,27,28; 29:5; 39:5,20,21; Lev 8:7). Hyphenated to mark crafted-girdle.
Stood with Ezra at law-reading (Neh 8:4). English convention: Hashbaddanah.
Son of Zerubbabel (1Chr 3:20). English convention: Hashubah.

Amorite capital, then Reubenite-Gadite-Levitical city (Num 21:25-34; 32:3,37; Deut 1:4; 2:24,26,30; 3:2,6; 4:46; 29:7; Josh 9:10; 12:2,5; 13:10,17,21,26,27; 21:39; Judg 11:19,26; 1Chr 6:81; Neh 9:22; Song 7:4; Isa 15:4; 16:8,9; Jer 48:2,34,45; 49:3). English convention: Heshbon.
Multiple Levites and post-exilic figures (1Chr 6:45; 9:14; 25:3,19; 26:30; 27:17; 2Chr 35:9; Ezr 8:19,24; Neh 3:17; 10:11; 11:15,22; 12:21,24). English convention: Hashabiah. 'YHWH-has-reckoned'.
Wall-builder and Levite (Neh 3:10; 9:5). English convention: Hashabneiah.
Multiple persons including wall-builder (1Chr 9:14; Neh 3:11,23; 10:24; 11:15). English convention: Hasshub.
Nethinim ancestor (Ezr 2:43; Neh 7:46). English convention: Hasupha.

Qal/Hi/Hophal: be-dark, become-darkened (Ex 10:15; 1Kgs 18:45; Job 3:9; 18:6; Ps 69:23; 105:28; Ecc 12:2,3; Isa 5:30; 13:10; Eze 30:18; 32:7,8; Mic 3:6; Lam 4:8; 5:17). Hyphenated to mark darkness-falling.
Gen 15:12; Isa 8:22; 50:10; Mic 3:6; Ps 82:5; 139:12. Hyphenated to mark dense-dark distinct from H2822 general darkness.
Post-exilic family-head (Ezr 2:19; 10:33; Neh 7:22; 8:4; 10:18). English convention: Hashum.
Negev town of Judah (Josh 15:27). English convention: Heshmon.
Eze 1:4,27; 8:2 — radiance of throne-vision. Hyphenated to preserve all candidate-glosses (electrum, glow-bronze, amber).
High-priest's pectoral with twelve stones and Urim-Thummim (Ex 25:7; 28:4,15-30; 29:5; 35:9,27; 39:8-21; Lev 8:8). Hyphenated to mark cultic-judgment-pouch.
Qal: lay-bare, uncover (Ps 29:9; Isa 20:4; 30:14; 47:2; 52:10; Jer 13:26; 49:10; Eze 4:7; Joel 1:7; Hag 2:16). Hyphenated.
Qal/Pi: be-attached-in-affection (Gen 34:8; Deut 7:7; 10:15; 21:11; 1Kgs 9:19; 2Chr 8:6; Ps 91:14; Isa 38:17). Hyphenated to mark covenant-affection distinct from H157 ahav love.
Pi/Pu: girt with silver fillets (Ex 27:17; 38:17,28). Hyphenated.
Gentilic of Hushah (2Sam 21:18; 23:27; 1Chr 11:29; 20:4; 27:11). English convention: Hushathite.
Son of Canaan, ancestor of Hittites (Gen 10:15; 23:3,5,7,10,16,18,20; 25:10; 27:46; 49:32; 1Chr 1:13). English convention: Heth.
Northern boundary site (Eze 47:15; 48:1). English convention: Hethlon.

Qal/Ni/Pi/Hi: seal, close-up (Lev 15:3; Deut 32:34; 1Kgs 21:8; Esth 3:12; 8:8,10; Job 9:7; 14:17; 24:16; 33:16; 37:7; Song 4:12; Isa 8:16; 29:11; Jer 32:10,11,14,44; Eze 28:12; Dan 6:17; 8:26; 9:24; 12:4,9; Neh 9:38; 10:1). Hyphenated to mark sealing-action distinct from H5640 satam shut.
Hithp: form-marriage-alliance (Gen 34:9; Deut 7:3; Josh 23:12; 1Sam 18:21-27; 1Kgs 3:1; 2Chr 18:1; Ezr 9:14). Hyphenated.
Hithp variant: become-related-by-marriage (1Sam 18:22,23,26,27). Hyphenated to distinguish from H2859a alliance-action.
Qal: break-through wall (Job 24:16; Eze 8:8; 12:5,7,12; Jonah 1:13; Amos 9:2). Hyphenated.

Qal: butcher-animal-or-people (Gen 43:16; Ex 21:37; 22:1; Deut 28:31; 1Sam 25:11; Ps 37:14; Prov 9:2; Isa 14:21; 22:13; 53:7; Jer 11:19; 12:3; 25:34; 51:40; Lam 2:21; Eze 21:10,15,28). Standard concordant 'slaughter'.
Aramean son of Nahor (Gen 22:24). English convention: Tebah.
Royal-executioner-and-cook (Gen 37:36; 39:1; 40:3,4; 41:10,12; 1Sam 9:23,24; 2Kgs 25:8-20; Jer 39:9-13; 40:1-5; 41:10; 43:6; 52:12-30; Lam 2:20). Hyphenated to preserve dual function.

Qal/Ni: immerse, dip (Gen 37:31; Ex 12:22; Lev 4:6,17; 9:9; 14:6,16,51; Num 19:18; Deut 33:24; Josh 3:15; Ruth 2:14; 1Sam 14:27; 2Kgs 5:14; 8:15; Job 9:31; Eze 23:15). Hyphenated to mark immersion-action.
Qal/Pu/Hophal: be-sunk-or-fixed (Ex 15:4; 1Sam 17:49; Job 38:6; Ps 9:15; 69:2,14; Prov 8:25; Jer 38:6,22; Lam 2:9). Hyphenated to mark sinking-or-fixing-into.
Nethinim ancestor (Ezr 2:43; Neh 7:46). English convention: Tabbaoth.
Tenth month of Hebrew calendar (Esth 2:16). Hyphenated. English convention: Tebeth.
Place to which Midianites fled (Judg 7:22). English convention: Tabbath.
Variant; clean, of glass-pavement of YHWH (Ex 24:10). Hyphenated.

Qal: be-pleasant, well, fitting (Num 24:1; Judg 11:25; 1Sam 16:23; 2Sam 3:36; 1Kgs 12:7; 2Chr 10:7; Esth 1:21; 2:4,9; Ps 13:6; 49:18; 119:68; Prov 3:30; 30:29; Ecc 7:3,10; Jer 18:4). Standard concordant.
Region east of Jordan (Judg 11:3,5; 2Sam 10:6,8). Hyphenated. English convention: Tob.
Levite teacher (2Chr 17:8). Hyphenated. English convention: Tob-adonijah.

Levite teacher and Ammonite-opponent of Nehemiah, post-exilic returnee (2Chr 17:8; Ezr 2:60; Neh 2:10,19; 4:3,7; 6:1,12,14,17,19; 7:62; 13:4,7,8; Zech 6:10,14). English convention: Tobiah. 'YHWH-is-good'.
Hi/Hophal/Pilpel: cast-out, hurl (1Sam 18:11; 20:33; Jer 16:13; 22:26,28; Jonah 1:4,5,12,15; Job 41:9 (Heb 41:1); Isa 22:17; Eze 32:4; Ps 37:24). Hyphenated.
Job 38:36; Ps 51:6. Hyphenated to mark inner-organs/inner-being.
Qal: grind grain or mill (Num 11:8; Deut 9:21; Judg 16:21; Job 31:10; Isa 3:15; 47:2; Lam 5:13; Ecc 12:3,4). Standard concordant 'grind'.
Wet-clay, miry-bog (2Sam 22:43; Ps 18:42; 40:2; 69:14; Isa 41:25; 57:20; Jer 38:6; Mic 7:10; Nah 3:14; Zech 9:3; 10:5). Hyphenated.
Fortified-encampment, dovecot (Gen 25:16; Num 31:10; 1Chr 6:54; Ps 69:25; Song 8:9; Eze 25:4). Hyphenated.
